triage.reason: The DG Environment news page reports that on 21 October 2026 the Commission opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging to inform an assessment of its technological development and environmental performance, a new plastics-packaging policy development.

draft.summary: The Commission opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging. The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.
